descriptor: Seed-Integrated Behavioral Estimands, Seed-Selection Bias, Monte-Carlo Measurement Convergence, Representation×Randomization Marginalization & Reproducible Hosted-Inference Measurement

predecessor.key_result: P48's seed-response span did not survive P49 manifold-identifiability requirements: rank grew essentially with the centered-seed ceiling and held-out-cell transport was not robust, even though some low-rank energy concentration remained.

theoretical_reframing.problem: Failure of realization-level seed geometry does not imply failure of a distribution-level measurement object. The scientifically relevant quantity may be a randomization-marginal estimand rather than any individual seed fingerprint.
theoretical_reframing.estimand: For model/interface m and representation vertex v, define J_m(v,R)=1 iff both valid and null semantic twins are adjudicated correct under randomization draw R. The primary object is pi_m(v)=E_R[J_m(v,R)].
theoretical_reframing.central_question: Can hosted LLM behavior support a reproducible representation-indexed marginal measurement surface even when individual randomization realizations lack an identifiable manifold?

gemini_explicit_randomization.randomization_coordinate: 32 fresh nominal API seeds 5001..5032, each used once for every fixed cell.

groq_implicit_randomization.randomization_coordinate: 32 repeated hosted inference draws under the same frozen contract; the Groq adapter exposes no explicit seed control.
groq_implicit_randomization.authority: Draw index is an exchangeable repetition label, not a seed surrogate.

measurement_interfaces.comparability_rule: The two interfaces are not assumed to share a stochastic mechanism or randomization measure. P50 asks whether marginal measurement is reproducible within each interface and whether the measurement principle transports across interfaces.

frozen_surface.cells: 64 calls per draw = 32 R/F/H/T/L vertices × valid/null twins.
frozen_surface.alias_rule: Exactly one alias per vertex: ABCD[vertex_index mod 4].
frozen_surface.archive_namespace: P48 fresh isomorphic namespace only, frozen for the entire stage.
frozen_surface.execution: Within each draw, all 64 cells are frozen-PRNG shuffled; model call order alternates by draw-position parity.

half_surface_reproducibility.statistic: Pearson correlation across 32 vertices between estimator-half pi_A(v) and independent target-half pi_B(v).

monte_carlo_convergence.curve: For n∈{1,2,4,8,16}, estimate pi_n(v) from the first n estimator-half draws and compute MSE to pi_B(v).
monte_carlo_convergence.null: 5000 paired sign-flips of the 32 vertex-level error improvements.

seed_or_draw_selection_bias.statistic: Across each vertex, average squared error of the 16 arbitrary single-draw geometries to pi_B minus squared error of the 16-draw marginal estimator to pi_B.
seed_or_draw_selection_bias.null: 5000 paired sign-flips across the 32 vertex-level bias reductions.
seed_or_draw_selection_bias.meaning: Quantifies the distortion introduced by reporting one arbitrary seed/draw instead of a randomization-integrated estimate.

primary_estimands.multiplicity: Six primary tests in one Holm FWER=0.05 family.

secondary_outputs: Full pi_A and pi_B surfaces and nested n=1,2,4,8,16 convergence curves.
Maximum absolute and RMS marginal-surface error versus the independent target half.
Per-draw deviation from pi_B and distribution of single-draw selection error.
Valid-only and null-only marginal correctness surfaces.
Representation-vertex ranking stability across independent halves.
Cross-interface correlation between the full 32-draw Gemini and GPT-OSS marginal surfaces; descriptive only.
Approximate Monte-Carlo standard errors sqrt(p(1-p)/n) by vertex; descriptive only.

gates.technical: All 4096 calls must be exact-schema successful; otherwise TECHNICAL_HOLD and only failed calls may be recovered.
gates.evaluation_artifact: Primary-vs-shadow disagreement >=10% in either interface triggers EVALUATION_ARTIFACT_DOMINANT.
gates.interface_marginal_estimand: Within an interface, all three primary statistics must be positive and survive the six-test Holm correction.
gates.cross_interface_measurement: Both Gemini-explicit and Groq-implicit interfaces independently satisfy interface_marginal_estimand.
gates.single_draw_bias: No claim about a general single-draw bias is allowed unless the precommitted selection-bias test rejects after Holm correction.

canonical_drive_sources: Atıl et al. (2025), Non-Determinism of Deterministic LLM System Settings in Hosted Environments, DOI 10.18653/v1/2025.eval4nlp-1.12.
Lior et al. (2025), RELIABLEEVAL: A Recipe for Stochastic LLM Evaluation via Method of Moments, DOI 10.18653/v1/2025.findings-emnlp.594.
Habba et al. (2025), DOVE: A Large-Scale Multi-Dimensional Predictions Dataset Towards Meaningful LLM Evaluation.
killed: Hosted LLM nondeterminism is already established.
Stochastic/method-of-moments LLM evaluation is already established.
Repeated sampling alone is not a novel contribution.
novelty_kill_and_literature.surviving_candidate: EPISTEME-specific transition from failed realization-level representation/seed geometry to a prospectively validated randomization-marginal representation estimand, with direct single-draw selection-bias quantification and transport across explicit-seed versus implicit hosted-randomness interfaces.

independence_from_other_labs.scope: P50 remains an EPISTEME measurement problem about hosted LLM response observables. MQR/NOMOS/P&K may donate methodological cautions, but their general epistemic, governance, or philosophical objects are not imported as the explanandum.

frozen_rules: Gemini seed numbers are nominal labels; Groq draw numbers are repetition labels.
No realization-level manifold or latent-state claim is revived by successful marginal convergence.
The target half is independent of the estimator half and is never used to tune prefixes, thresholds, or statistics.
A reproducible marginal estimand is interface-relative unless independently constituted in both interfaces.
No provider-internal, neural RNG, batching, or hardware mechanism is identified.
No threshold, prefix, null model, multiplicity rule, or cell definition changes after outcomes.
No behavioral SVEC promotion follows from P50 alone.
